info.name: OptimaTech LMS - Backend API
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for the OptimaTech LMS NestJS backend (86 REST endpoints).

## Setup
1. Select this collection > **Variables** tab.
2. Set `authToken` to a valid **Firebase ID token** (the collection sends it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on every request except the Public ones).
3. `baseUrl` defaults to the Railway production deploy. For local dev, change it to `http://localhost:3000/api/v1`.
4. Fill the id variables (`courseId`, `sectionId`, `lectureId`, `quizId`, ...) as you go - the request URLs reference them.

## Notes
- Auth levels are noted in each request's description: **Public** / **User** / **Instructor/Admin** / **Owner** / **enrolled**.
- Public routes (health, catalog list, ratings list/summary) override auth to `noauth`.
- `POST /me/sync` must be the first authenticated call after sign-in.
- Discovery/read data (popular, recommended, search, categories, curriculum browsing) is served via the Firebase Data Connect client SDK, not REST - only the REST routes that actually exist in the backend are included here.
- Global prefix is `/api/v1` (already baked into `baseUrl`). Rate limit: 100 req / 60s.

request.description: Provision/refresh the caller's user row. **User.** Call once after first sign-in, before any other authed call.
Current user + profile + roles. **User.** Returns null if never synced.
Update own profile. **User.** All fields optional.
Assign global role via custom claim. **Admin only.** role in admin|instructor|student.

item.name: 4. Catalog (discovery)
item.description: Most discovery/read data should be fetched via the FDC client SDK (see API doc s0.5). These two remain on REST.

request.description: Descriptions of every uploaded VIDEO lecture. **User**, access-gated.
Create a course. **Instructor/Admin.** level in BEGINNER|INTERMEDIATE|ADVANCED. price in minor units.
Instructor analytics: content counts, enrollment breakdown, completion/progress, ratings. **Owner** (admin unconditional).
Update course. **Owner.** All fields optional (same shape as create + thumbnail).
Publish/unpublish/archive. **Owner.** status in DRAFT|PUBLISHED|ARCHIVED. Publishing needs >=1 section each with >=1 lecture.
**Owner.** orderedIds must be the complete set of the course's section IDs (dashed v4 UUIDs).
**Owner.** type in VIDEO|READING|INTERACTIVE|QUIZ. VIDEO needs videoUrl; READING needs content.
**Owner.** Target section must be in the same course.
Student-facing content (signed URLs). **User**, access-gated (owner/admin or active/completed enrollee, or free preview).
**User.** Idempotent (reactivates a dropped enrollment). No body required.
**User.** Source of truth for 'is the course completed'. May return null.
**User.** High-frequency; queued. Completion is derived server-side at 90% - never send completed here.

**User.** Synchronous progress write when the client needs the result immediately. Completion is derived server-side (≥90% of the lecture duration); the legacy `completed` field is accepted but ignored. Returns `{ "success": true, "completed": <bool> }`.
Attach a quiz to a QUIZ-type lecture. One quiz per lecture. timeLimitMinutes optional (untimed if omitted).
options requires >=2 and >=1 correct. points optional (>=0).
Full desired option set: insert without id, update with id, delete anything omitted. Incoming ids must belong to this question.
Resolve the quiz attached to a QUIZ lecture when the client only holds a lectureId. Student-safe (no isCorrect). 404 if the lecture has no quiz.
Student-safe view (no isCorrect). Render the quiz from this.
No body. 403 if no active enrollment / max attempts exceeded; 400 if an attempt is already in progress.
Attempt-owner enforced. 410 Gone if the session timed out (response includes the auto-grade payload).
No body. Finalizes + grades. Returns score/passed/totalPoints/...
No body. Keep a timed attempt alive / check remaining time.
**Owner.** multipart/form-data (NOT JSON). Fields: file (required), title (1-200 chars).
**User**, access-gated (owner/admin or active/completed enrollee). fileUrl is a short-lived signed read URL.
**User (student), enrolled.** Upload the file first (Uploads), then submit its URL. fileUrl <=2000 chars.
**Instructor/Admin.** Both fields optional; each score >=0. Grading marks the mission enrollment COMPLETED.
**Owner.** entityType in COURSE_THUMBNAIL|LECTURE_VIDEO|LECTURE_TRANSCRIPT. Then PUT bytes directly to the returned uploadUrl (no token), then confirm.
**Owner.** Persists the reference. For LECTURE_VIDEO this auto-enqueues transcoding.
**User**, access-gated. Returns rewritten HLS manifest text. Give the URL to an HLS player; don't parse it. `v` is optional and normally set by the player.
**User**, same gate as manifest. Use the `text` field as an overlay.
**User, enrolled.** Raw 16-byte AES-128 key. The player calls this automatically; needs both the Firebase token (header) and kt (query).
**Owner.** No body. Points the lecture videoUrl at already-uploaded HLS master. Usually the transcoder does this automatically.
**Owner.** Queue secure-HLS packaging. sourcePath <=1024 chars, must belong to this lecture.
